headers.comment: Default for every request path, including clean URLs like /lobbying/ that no extension glob can match. Revalidation is a 304 when nothing changed, so a nightly rebuild is picked up the next visit instead of up to an hour later.
Content-hashed build assets can never change under a given name.
Pagefind ships hashed index shards alongside its entry script.

Security headers. HSTS is already supplied by Firebase. The CSP is the one to watch: /my-reps loads the Census geocoder via JSONP, and GoatCounter's counter comes from gc.zgo.at, so both are allow-listed by host rather than the policy being loosened.

headers.value: geolocation=(self), camera=(), microphone=(), payment=(), usb=(), interest-cohort=()

default-src 'self'; base-uri 'self'; object-src 'none'; frame-ancestors 'none'; form-action 'self'; script-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline' https://gc.zgo.at https://geocoding.geo.census.gov; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; img-src 'self' data: https:; font-src 'self'; connect-src 'self' https://badgerpolitics.goatcounter.com; manifest-src 'self'
